title: Check the Model Guide
bottom_line: Find out whether Anthropic's model guide still matches the stored copy. Unchanged answers instantly. A change reports only differences in meaning.

blocks.text: It needs network access to claude.dev and Python 3.

blocks.caption: The two ways the command ends.

blocks.title: What you see
rows: The page text hashes to the stored value.
The page changed in wording or layout only.
The new hash and today's date.
A recommendation, model, effort level, price or rule changed. Each is shown old against new.
Nothing. You decide what to update.
No network or the page layout broke the check.

sections.heading: A hash makes the usual answer fast

steps.title: Fetches the page
steps.text: It reduces the page to its visible text and takes a sha256 hash.

steps.title: Compares with the stored hash
steps.text: The hash is kept next to the stored guide copy. Equal means unchanged and it stops.

steps.title: Compares meaning if different
steps.text: Wording or navigation can change the hash, so the model compares the live text with the stored guide and ignores anything that does not change a recommendation.

next_action.detail: Run it before you rely on `/model-picker:pick-model` after a long time.
